alarm.driver: Almond Delight (saffron and gulkand melt risk) and Dry Fruit Meetha Paan (chocolate-coated fruit) on shipments to Delhi, Hyderabad and Lucknow. 7 complaints in 7 days vs 3 prior. Two are public (one Instagram comment, one Google review at 2 stars). Meta campaign Summer Gifting Almond Delight Hot Cities (META-004) scaled from Rs 2,610/day to Rs 6,235/day in the same week.
alarm.recommended_action: Activate Ops SOP-01 (Summer Shipping) by EOD Tuesday. Insulated boxes plus gel pack plus courier switch on the Delhi, Hyderabad and Lucknow lanes. Cost approximately Rs 4,800/month. Founder personally calls the 7 complaint customers Monday and Tuesday. Owner: Ops Manager plus founder. Pause META-004 hot-cities targeting until SOP-01 is live.
